title: feat(pm): `pm:awaiting-merge` — a PR awaiting the maintainer's review and merge no longer shares `needs-user-decision` with decision cards
body:
Fixes #29745

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:新增 PR 专用标签 `pm:awaiting-merge`(等您审核并合并的 PR 挂它,永不挂 issue);`needs-user-decision` 只留给决策卡(issue)。SKILL.md 复核 ② 与状态表改读法;总监呈批、分诊轮次记录、轮次报告健康指标、车队总表都把「决策卡 N」与「待您审合 PR M」分开计。巡查 H48 与交接检查 `acceptedPullWait` 改读新标签。
- **为什么改**:您的裁决「同意 pm:awaiting-merge」(A):一个标签两种意思,决策箱计数把等您回一个字的卡和等您点合并的 PR 混在一起,呈批分不开。
- **风险与回滚**:不新增门禁、不改六态互斥。风险只在过渡期:本 PR 落地后,巡查 H48 会把仍挂旧标签的受管 PR(现有一张,见 Acceptance notes)报为「缺 `pm:awaiting-merge`」,席位换标即清。回滚 = revert 本 PR;GitHub 上的标签对象留着无害。
- **先看**:① `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`:新常量 `GOVERNED_PR_AWAITING_MERGE_LABEL` 与 `DECISION_INBOX_LABEL`,及 H48 读标签的 hunk(唯一改行为的 hunk);② `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`:复核 ② 行与状态表 `needs-user-decision` 行;③ `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`:新标签行与改写的 `needs-user-decision` 描述。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test`,预期末行 `✓ fleet-roster self-test: 115 cases in 9 batteries pass.`;再 `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,预期 SKILL.md 仍 319 行、五个 references 行数不变。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(落地时席位跑 `bash scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh --reconcile` 建标签,并给仍挂旧标签的 PR 换标)。

## What changes

The maintainer's ruling on the card (verbatim: 「同意 pm:awaiting-merge」, option A). One label, two inboxes: a PR that waits on the maintainer's own review and merge used to carry `needs-user-decision`, the same label as a decision card, so the decision count mixed "a letter owed" with "a review and a click owed".

1. **The label** — `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` gains `pm:awaiting-merge` ("PR only: landing waits on the maintainer's own review and merge (SKILL.md 复核 ②); never on an issue", in the per-repo loop, 100-char cap respected) with its named readers in the comment. `needs-user-decision`'s description now says "decision cards only, never on a PR". Kept as is: `pm:awaiting-maintainer` (an issue, a human act outside GitHub). No new gate.
2. **SKILL.md** (net 0 lines, every edited line ≤120 bytes): 复核 ② now says 「同笔挂 `pm:awaiting-merge`」; the next clause says it is PR-only and outside the six states; the state-table row says `needs-user-decision` = decision cards (issues) only, never a PR; the preamble names the maintainer's three entry points.
3. **Readers** list the two inboxes apart — 「决策卡 N」 and 「待您审合 PR M」:
   - `references/lanes/director.md` (the director's batch and daily digest), `references/triage-duties.md` (triage round records; `needs-user-decision` = issues only), `references/seat-lifecycle.md` (the round report's health metric), `references/state-machine.md` (the six states are all issue states). Each reference that grew a line paid for it inside the same file by deleting a duplicated line (details under Acceptance notes); the others were rewritten in place.
   - `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`: H48 (a governed PR with an ACCEPT verdict must carry the label) now reads `GOVERNED_PR_AWAITING_MERGE_LABEL` = `pm:awaiting-merge`. The card readers that had been reusing the PR constant (H52, H62, H73, the ④ dependents index and its renderer) read `DECISION_INBOX_LABEL` = `needs-user-decision`. Pinned: the old shape (`needs-user-decision` on a PR) no longer satisfies H48's label half; the new label is not one of `PM_EXCLUSIVE_STATE_LABELS`.
   - `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs`: `acceptedPullWait` reads the new label on the stay-behind pull; pinned that the old shape is no longer a wait.
   - `scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs`: a new "awaiting merge" column (pulls carrying the label that close an in-flight card of the seat, attributed like "awaiting landing"; no new read — labels ride on the open-pulls listing) and an inbox line under the table: 「决策卡 N · 待您审合 PR M」, counted apart and never summed. `--json` carries the same `inboxes` totals. Fixture: pull 25427 carries the label.
   - The 终局四件套 prose in `dispatch-gates.mjs`, `check-governed-merges.mjs` and `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` names the new label on the PR.
4. **The open PRs in the old shape** — ruling item 4 named PR #29698, which merged on 2026-11-03 (moot). The search `org:objectstack-ai is:pr is:open label:needs-user-decision` at dispatch time returned four: objectstack#30263 (the ADR-0148 docs PR) and three outside the label loop (duly#157, duly#142, www.objectos.ai#327). Relabelling is a label write and belongs to the landing seat, not to this PR's write budget.

## Tests

Self-tests of every touched script, run on the final head (readings under Verification):

- `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` — 115 cases in 9 batteries pass (110 on `origin/main`; 5 new: the column, the retired shape counts nowhere, `inboxTotals`, the inbox line, no inbox line without totals; the import pin now also asserts no second spelling of the label).
- `node scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs --self-test` — 67 cases pass (66 on `origin/main`; 1 new: the retired shape is no longer a wait).
- `pnpm check:pm-half-states` (`check-half-states.mjs --self-test`) — 5224 cases pass (2 new: the old shape no longer satisfies H48's label half; the PR constant is `pm:awaiting-merge` and not one of the six card states), with H48's existing cases re-pinned on the new label.
- `pnpm check:pm-label-desc-cap` — 45 descriptions ≤100 chars (longest 100, the pre-existing `tooling`).
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` — SKILL.md 319/319, state-machine 41/41, triage-duties 100/100, seat-lifecycle 98/98, director 86/86; no edited line over 120 bytes.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` — green.

No ablation: the behaviour change is label-name plumbing pinned by the self-tests above; nothing under `packages/*` moved.

## Acceptance notes

- **Paying the line ratchets** (every ceilinged file at headroom 0; the currency is deleted content, never a re-wrap):
  - `lanes/director.md`: +1 line (待您审合箱 and the two-count rule) paid by deleting 「本席任何形态都纯召唤制,⛔ 无任何 routine;分诊席默认同项目召唤,职责见 `triage.md`」 — its first half repeats line 7 (「授权面 = 人工召唤 … 直连 ⛔ 无 Routine/cron」), its second half repeats `lanes/triage.md` line 4 (「由维护者一句召唤到任一项目,默认同总监席项目」).
  - `triage-duties.md`: +1 line (round records split the two counts) paid by deleting 「Backlog sweep 是常设职责,每 fire 扫任一析取命中的卡」, which line 19 (「首触定级与五析取 sweep 每 fire 跑到清空 …」) subsumes.
  - `seat-lifecycle.md`, `state-machine.md`, `SKILL.md`: rewritten in place, net 0.
- **The GitHub label object is not created by this PR**: no relay op creates labels, so creation stays a landing step — `bash scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh --reconcile` on the loop's repos, which also rewrites `needs-user-decision`'s live description (the create-only default would leave the old text). `pm:awaiting-merge` answered 404 on this repo at dispatch time.
- **Carrier: the landing seat** — relabel objectstack#30263 (`needs-user-decision` → `pm:awaiting-merge`); the three PRs in `duly` and `www.objectos.ai` sit in repos outside `ensure-pm-labels.sh`'s loop, so their shape is a seat decision, noted and not filed.
- **Boundary, not filed** (ruling: no new gate): nothing patrols `pm:awaiting-merge` on an ISSUE, and `label-write.mjs` cannot tell an issue from a PR without a read; the rule lives in SKILL.md and the label's description.
- **Untouched on purpose**: `board-snapshot.mjs`, `references/landing-operations.md`, `references/contract-review.md` (named as clues) do not read the label; `fleet-roster.mjs`'s "awaiting ruling" already excluded pulls; the six-state mutex and `PM_EXCLUSIVE_STATE_LABELS` are unchanged.
- **skip-changeset**: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing from any released package.

## Verification

Final head `0cf500af` (every reading below was taken on this tree; base `fdd06415` on `origin/main`). No package is touched, so no ① dependency-closure build and no ② package test is owed; `test:repo` and the farm-wide scans are CI's.

**Derived families.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 63 commands from the 13 changed files. Every one ran in the worktree with its exit code captured before any pipe (`bash -c CMD >> log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`). Reconciliation, `dispatch-gates --ran` over the recorded `command :: exit code` lines: 「63 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 63 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)」.

- One command, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`, first exited 3 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET (`@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt; by the gate's own text「Nothing was measured … NOT a finding」). After `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 2s · waited 0s) it exits 0; the reconciliation above is the post-rerun one.
- Local-only families (`check:dev-prereqs`, `check:skill-frame-freshness`) are not named by the derivation: neither `packages/spec` nor the four-axis frame files moved.
- CI: the same families run in `Lint & Repo Gates`; the report comment cites the PR's check-runs by name once they exist, not a local re-run.
